title: Ellaz fight mode file
description: The one file a game names. It points at an arena, a match ruleset and a cast; data/load.ts opens everything it names and compile.ts refuses any name that was not loaded. `seed` lives here and not in code so a replay is a mode file plus an input log, and nothing else.

seed.description: the whole state of the sim's rng; uint32

castEntry.description: `ai` is REQUIRED when control is "ai" and FORBIDDEN otherwise. The validator subset (scripts/lib/schema.mjs) has no if/then and no oneOf, so that conditional cannot be written here and is asserted by data.test.ts instead - watched failing in both directions before it was believed.

ai.description: a basename under ../ai/; see the conditional above

x.description: view px; inside the arena's sim.xMin..xMax

z.description: view px; inside the arena's sim.zMin..zMax

face.description: 1 or -1; data.test.ts asserts it, the subset has no enum
